Next I’ll read `shell.js` and the four modules so the helper matches existing style.I have the shell export and the four modules; next I’ll read the remaining render paths so the helper can own each heading without duplicating intros.I’ll add `setViewHeading` on the shell, then wire the four modules so each view has one `h2` and no repeated intro.`HRL_SHELL.setViewHeading` now owns each view’s `h2` and static hint. The four modules update that heading and drop the duplicate title/intro they used to inject.

### 1. `setViewHeading` signature and guards

```js
HRL_SHELL.setViewHeading(viewName, headingText, hideHint)
```

- Looks up `#view-<viewName>`.
- If `headingText` is a **non-empty string**, sets the view’s first `h2` via `textContent`. `null` / `undefined` / `''` leave the heading alone.
- Sets the view’s first `p.hint` to `hidden = !!hideHint` (true hides, false shows).
- Returns quietly if `document` is missing, `viewName` is empty, the view is missing, `querySelector` is missing, or the `h2` / hint is missing. Nothing throws.

### 2. Per-module heading text and removed duplicates

**`learn.js`**
| Screen | `h2` | Hint | Removed from injected markup |
|---|---|---|---|
| Chapter | chapter title | hidden | the extra `<h3 class="chapter-title">` (kicker, subtitle, hero kept) |
| Chapter missing | `"Chapter"` | hidden | — |
| Path | unchanged (`"My Path"`) | left visible | none (no duplicate intro) |
| Glossary | unchanged (`"Glossary"`) | left visible | none |

**`placement.js`**
| Screen | `h2` | Hint | Removed |
|---|---|---|---|
| First / self-report | `"Find your starting point"` | hidden | panel heading `"Find your starting point"` |
| Probe | same | hidden | repeated intro sentence |
| Result | `"Your starting point"` | hidden | — |

The intro sentence stays **once**, in the first-screen panel. Skip control is still prepended on every screen.

**`quiz.js`**
| Screen | `h2` | Hint | Removed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Chapter quiz | `"{title} — quiz"` (fallback `"Chapter quiz"`) | hidden | injected `p.hint` that repeated the title |
| Review deck / session | unchanged (`"Review"`) | hidden | same injected title line |

**`iq.js`**
| Screen | `h2` | Hint | Removed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Intro, test, result | unchanged (`"Baseball IQ"`) | hidden | no extra `"Baseball IQ"` heading on the score card (there wasn’t one; score / band / blurb only) |

### 3. Untouched files

`index.html`, `styles.css`, and all content data files were not modified.

### 4. Deviation

Chapter section headings (and example / coach-note titles) were promoted from `<h4>` to `<h3>`. Dropping the injected chapter title would otherwise skip from the view `h2` to `h4`. Compare-column titles and glossary term names stay `<h4>` under those `<h3>`s.

I did not run tests or a browser pass; this brief forbids shell access.
